home.servicesLead: Four things I do for clients, described plainly.
home.projectsLead: Systems running today. Each card says what problem it solved.
home.ctaTitle: Tell me about the manual process
home.ctaText: Describe the task your team repeats every day. First consultation is free and you will get my honest opinion — including if a simple spreadsheet beats custom software.
home.testimonialsLead: Feedback from people who use these systems daily.
home.step1Text: First we talk. Tell me what eats your time every day; I will honestly tell you whether you need software at all, or a plain spreadsheet is enough.
home.step2Text: I build for how you actually work, not from a template. Along the way you see the thing taking shape and steer it.
home.step3Text: At hand-off you do not get a file and my back. We work with your team until it is actually running. And I stay after, because software ages.
home.bioText: I dislike repetitive work — especially someone doing the same task by hand every day while a computer sits right there. So I build bots and small software: I listen first, learn how the work really happens, then build the smallest tool that takes that task away. I talk less than I show.
